description: A brushed DC motor on one channel of a motor driver. It speeds up and slows down along ramps, never in one jump, goes through stop when it changes direction, ignores a dead zone round stop, starts at the speed where it turns, keeps under a top speed and can be trimmed and reversed. It can stop itself when it stalls.

fields.label: Motor driver
fields.description: The motor driver the motor is wired to (a device with the H-bridge contract)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: The driver's channel the motor is on: a bridge (OUT1+OUT2, OUT3+OUT4), or one output when the driver runs half bridges

fields.label: One direction
fields.description: A motor on a half bridge (one lead to ground): forward only

fields.label: Reverse direction
fields.description: Swaps forward and reverse, instead of swapping the motor's wires

fields.label: At stop
fields.description: What the motor does at speed 0: brake (stops fast and holds) or coast (rolls to a stop)

fields.label: Top speed
fields.description: The highest drive: a motor rated under the supply runs at most this (a 6 V motor on 12 V: 50 %)

fields.label: Start speed
fields.description: The drive where the motor starts turning: any speed past the dead zone starts here, so the motor never just hums. At most the top speed

fields.label: Dead zone
fields.description: A speed under it is a stop (joystick or slider noise round the middle)

fields.label: Trim
fields.description: Scales the drive by this many percent, to match the motor to its pair (a robot that drives straight)

fields.label: Ramp up
fields.description: Time from stop to full speed: the motor speeds up along it, never in one jump. 0 = at once

fields.label: Ramp down
fields.description: Time from full speed to stop. 0 = at once

fields.label: Reverse pause
fields.description: A change of direction goes through stop and waits this long there (spares the gearbox, no current spike)

fields.label: Stall current
fields.description: A current at or over it, held for the stall time, is a stall: the motor stops and a STALL event is sent. Needs the bridge channel's current sense. 0 = not watched

fields.label: Stall time
fields.description: How long the stall current lasts before the motor stops (past the start-up surge)

presets.label: TT gear motor (3-6 V)
presets.description: Yellow TT gear motor of small robots

commands.label: Speed
commands.description: The speed the motor runs at: it gets there along the ramps

read.description: The speed last set (where the motor is going)

fields.label: Speed
fields.description: Percent: -100 (full reverse) to 100 (full forward); 0 to 100 for a motor on one direction

write.description: Sets the speed; a change of direction goes through stop

fields.label: Speed
fields.description: Percent: -100 (full reverse) to 100 (full forward); 0 to 100 for a motor on one direction

commands.label: Output
commands.description: Where the ramp is now: the speed the motor is running at

fields.label: Output
fields.description: Percent the motor runs at now

commands.label: Stop
commands.description: Slows down to stop along the ramp, then brakes or coasts (At stop)

commands.label: Brake
commands.description: Stops at once, no ramp: shorts the motor

commands.label: Coast
commands.description: Stops driving at once, no ramp: the motor rolls free

commands.label: Settings
commands.description: The motor's settings, changed live. The read answers them.
